well: IODP Holes 385-U1545A/B (503.3 m penetration, deepest sample 456.71 mbsf), 385-U1547B (Ringvent sill site), 385-U1550B, 385-U1551B - GUAYMAS BASIN, Gulf of California (27.21-27.64 N, 111.22-111.89 W; seafloors -1,593.5 to -2,001.2 m), a young rift basin where magmatic sills intrude organic-rich diatomaceous sediment - one of the hottest sedimented basins ever drilled; PLUS two Alvin submersible dives (AT37-06 4864/4865, 2016) sampling the water column ABOVE the seafloor at -3 and -2 m depth - the catalogue's first submersible events and first negative-depth samples
operator_on_log: Knoke, Boening, Dittmar, Friebe, Gruendken, Guenther, Klaproth, Ulber, Simon & Seidel (ICBM Oldenburg / UNC) EA-IRMS stable carbon isotope analysis of solid-phase-extracted dissolved organic matter, porewater vs hot-water Soxhlet extracts (the extraction simulating hydrothermal DOM mobilization); drilling by JOIDES Resolution, IODP Expedition 385 (2019)

source_anomaly_disclosure: FOUR source quirks preserved verbatim: (1) sample label 385-U1545B-27F-2 appears TWICE as porewater at two DIFFERENT depths (186.94 and 191.89 m) - one row is presumably a mislabeled neighbouring core, carried as-is; (2) two pooled-sample ID strings have concatenation glitches with a missing underscore ('_5H2385_U1545_B_4H2' and '_5H3385_U1551_B_3H6'); (3) the delta13C parameter comment carries the archive's own typos verbatim ('surficient', 'Sampled that have been pooled haver been'); (4) the two Alvin rows and one U1547B pooled row have EMPTY delta13C cells - negative-result blanks preserved, and the Alvin rows put the geocode ABOVE the seafloor (-3/-2 m)
purpose: thirty-fifth catalogue entry - the GUAYMAS BASIN joins as region TWENTY-THREE (the catalogue's first sill-intruded hydrothermal rift basin, the Gulf of California) and stable carbon isotopes are kind TWENTY-FOUR, the catalogue's first isotope data; the paper's hydrothermal-mobilization headline is re-derived by the gate as arithmetic on every run: the hot-water Soxhlet extracts (simulating what hydrothermal circulation strips from the particulate phase) are systematically 13C-ENRICHED relative to ambient porewater DOM (+0.49 permil mean offset, -22.04 vs -22.53), while every single value stays inside the marine-organic window - no thermogenic excursion beyond -24.25
verified: 77 rows / 228 counted cells against the header's own Size declaration (EXACT: 77x2 label cells + 74 measured values, with the 3 blanks the closure demands); all 74 values in [-24.25, -21.25]; phase-offset headline pinned (mean Soxhlet minus mean porewater = +0.487 permil, computed live); the 27F-2 duplicate-label pair pinned at both depths; the two negative-depth Alvin rows pinned with empty values; both glitched pooled-ID strings pinned; gate-pinned; source URL serves the identical dataset
